textbookText: human activities. Among many ozone depleting substances CFCs are the most contributing ozone depleting substances. CFCs are chlorinated and fluorinated methane and ethane derivatives commonly known as Freons. Some common examples of Freons are CFCl3 (Freon-11), CF2Cl2(Freon-12), CF3Cl (Freon-13), C2F2Cl4 (Freon-112), etc.

Figure 9.11: Satellites track the health of the ozone layer Note: Freons are extremely stable, non-reactive, non-flammable and non-toxic substances. They can be easily liquefied at room temperature. These special properties of Freons make them to be used as refrigerants in refrigerators and air conditioners. Freon's such asfreon-11 are used in the production of plastic foams.
